gcrosshair_base89 preset-pack-192-abi3-outline-vector-only-INI-recipes

Core
- include/gcrosshair89_types.h (ABI 3, synchronized with params/core)
- include/gcrosshair_base89.h
- include/gcrosshair_recipe89.h
- src/gcrosshair_base89.c (catalog API bridge; no compiled preset tables)
- src/gcrosshair_recipe89.c (fixed-capacity INI loader)
- src/gcrosshair_recipe89_internal.h

Recipe data
- recipes/gcrosshair.ini (root)
- recipes/lists/base192.ini (ordered stock catalog)
- recipes/presets/*.ini (192 stock presets)
- recipes/parts/abi3_defaults.ini (shared fragment)
- recipes/assets/assets.ini (asset ID mapping)
- recipes/examples/gcrosshair_modded.ini (stock + ID 192 extension example)
- recipes/examples/parts/*.ini
- recipes/examples/presets/*.ini
- recipes/examples/lists/*.ini

Documentation
- RECIPE_SYSTEM.md
- README.md
- PRESET_CATALOG.csv / .md / .png
- PRESET_DESIGN_NOTES.md
- VECTOR_ONLY_MIGRATION.md
- SHAPE_RENDER_CONTRACT.md
- INTEGRACION_BLANK3D.md
- VALIDATION.txt
- CHANGELOG.md

Examples/tests
- examples/example_preset.c
- examples/example_catalog.c
- examples/example_abi3.c
- examples/example_recipe_root.c
- tests/test_base.c
- tests/test_recipe_loader.c

Build
- Makefile
- build_win32_mingw.bat

Legacy assets
- assets/*.tga
